user.title: Shady
user.description:
Corrected solar forecast as HA sensors.

Correction is computed via linear regression (with ±1h neighbour smoothing at 50 % weight) over the last N days – separately for each configured PV string.

data.use_effective_sensors: Use loss-adjusted effective sensors for model correction

data_description.algorithm: Algorithm used to compute the per-hour shading correction
data_description.grid_import: Power the BMS draws from the house grid (e.g. to charge the battery). Positive = import. Leave empty if not available.
data_description.grid_export: Power the BMS feeds into the house grid (from PV and/or battery discharge). Positive = export. Leave empty if not available.
data_description.battery_import: Power flowing into the battery (charging). Positive = charging. Leave empty if not available.
data_description.battery_export: Power flowing out of the battery (discharging). Positive = discharging. Leave empty if not available.
data_description.use_effective_sensors: When enabled, the correction model uses the loss-adjusted effective PV sensor values instead of the raw PV sensors.
